notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
We want to thank all the players who rated the CALL OF LDPR project, thanks to you we have an incentive to improve the game and add additional content to it.

In this update, we added additional achievements for those who had little nerve to play through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39519683/44df798ca5fedb7bc77216715f0fd7f26945d03e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Outline: Complete the game without drinking a beer.
[*] Why ?: Kill some pigeons.
[*] Yegoryevsky millionaire: Earn 954 rubles.
[*] Forgot the machine gun at home: Clear CyberNet's office using only a pistol.
[/list]

We advise you to be patient if you suddenly decide to complete the game without using a beer or a machine ...

Also a few major fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] The sight now does not disappear after cutscenes
[*] After going to the BNV, the character does not get into a stupor before the bath
[*] Added more flexible effect settings (Bloom, Motion Blur)
[*] Fixed beer indicator in the bath scene, now it does not say "-1"
[*] Attempt to fix black screens for owners of integrated Intel (R) HD Graphics.
[*] The grandmas are now easier to pass (possibly ːsenpaiː)
[/list]

To fix black screens, we changed the settings for the graphics preset "Well", which should be used by owners of Intel (R) HD Graphics. Before starting the game after the update, you should delete the following file -% appdata% / LocalLow / MEHSOFT / CALL OF LDPR / ldprsecretdocuments.txt.
